title: A right adjoint of an exact triangulated functor is exact
standard_prerequisites: Triangulated TR3 and representable long exact sequences; adjunction/counit naturality; Yoneda and the five lemma.
core_obligations: Construct the adjoint shift comparison from the counit, and identify its action with the natural Yoneda Hom bijection.
Complete a counit map of distinguished triangles under F, transfer its third map through adjunction, and prove the comparison X→G(C) is an isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: After the permitted adjunction/counit, Yoneda, TR3 and five-lemma inputs, the shift comparison and triangle comparison are formal transport of those structures. No further nonroutine mechanism survives the input boundary. This is below the present H2 bar.
